Clean mushrooms and slice them, cut spring onions into fine rings. Heat sesame oil in a pan and fry the mushrooms for 5 minutes. Stir Misopaste with soy sauce and 3 tablespoons of pasta boiling water and add to the mushrooms.
Swirl the pasta in the pan with the misosauce and sprinkle with spring onions.

Clean mushrooms and slice them, peel onion and dice finely. Cut hip steak across the fiber into thin strips. Heat a coated pan at high heat. Fry the strips in it for 1–2 minutes, salt, pepper and remove. Fry mushrooms and onion in the same pan for 4–5 minutes, stir in scourage and mustard and boil briefly; return the meat and heat only.

Cut turkey breast into thin strips, salt and pepper and fry in a coated pan without fat at medium heat for 6-8 minutes until they are completely cooked. Peel the peppers and dice them small, peel the onion and dice them finely. Sauté the peppers and onion in the same pan for 4 minutes, stir in fresh cheese with 3 tbsp. of cooking water and add the meat again.

Peel garlic and chop finely, cut olives into rings, wash and dice tomatoes. Sweat garlic briefly in a coated pan, add pasted tomatoes, tomato cubes, olives and capers and simmer for 8-10 minutes; pepper (salts usually not necessary).

Rinse prawns and pat dry, cut the fillet of saithe into mouth-appropriate pieces, chop garlic finely. Sweat garlic in a coated pan, add pastry tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Place the fish and shrimp in the sauce and let it draw for 4–5 minutes in a small heat; add salt, pepper and parsley (hacked).
Chop walnuts coarsely and fry briefly in a pan without fat. Heat cream in the pan, melt Gorgonzola in it in a small heat and let the pear cubes be carried with you for 1 minute; pepper.
Mix pasta with the sauce and sprinkle with the walnuts.
Wash the pumpkin, drain it and cut into 1 cm small cubes. Melt butter in a pan, fry the pumpkin for 8-10 minutes, fry herbs (best sage) for the last minute; salt. Rub Parmesan finely.
Add pasta with 2–3 tablespoons of cooking water to the pumpkin, swirl and sprinkle with parmesan.

Remove asparagus from the woody ends and cut into 3–4 cm long pieces. Sauce cream with lemon juice and salt in a coated pan with 2 tablespoons of water for 4–5 minutes. Mix sour cream with lemon juice and salt; finely rub Parmesan.
Remove the pan from the stove, mix pasta, asparagus and lemon sauce and sprinkle with parmesan.
Roast tomato paste in a coated pan for 1 minute, add pasted tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes. Stir in mascarpone until the sauce is creamy; add salt, pepper and basil.
Dice the onion finely, cut the ham into strips. Fry the onion and ham in a coated pan for 2–3 minutes, add peas and cream and simmer for 3–4 minutes; pepper.

Cut the olives into rings, wash and halve the cherry tomatoes, wash and drain the spinach (thaw the TK-spinach and squeeze it well). Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the tomatoes and olives in it for 2 minutes, add the spinach and let it fall together.
Mix pasta with the vegetables and fry over feta.
Boil plenty of salt water and boil penne in it according to the package (about 10–12 minutes).
Boil plenty of salt water and cook whole-grain noodles according to the package (about 10–12 minutes).
Boil plenty of salt water and cook Rigatoni in it according to the package (about 11–13 minutes).
Boil plenty of salt water and cook lentil noodles in it for 6-8 minutes according to the package – no longer, otherwise they will become soft and disintegrate.
Place rice noodles in boiling water, pull from the stove and leave to draw for 4-6 minutes according to the package, then drain and rinse briefly cold so that they do not stick.
Drain the rice noodles well, add to the sauce, gently swirl and serve immediately.
Place gnocchi in boiling salt water and lift out with a foam cell as soon as they swim on the surface (2–3 minutes).
Drain the gnocchi well, add to the sauce, gently swirl and serve immediately.
Cook tortellini in boiling salt water for 2–4 minutes according to the package.
Drain the tortellini well, add to the sauce, gently swirl and serve immediately.
Let ravioli soak in boiling salt water for 3–4 minutes – do not fry so that they do not burst.
Drain the ravioli well, add to the sauce, gently swirl and serve immediately.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C above/underheat. Wash potatoes and quarter with peel. Mix the potatoes with half of the olive oil, salt and herbs (best rosemary) and bake on a sheet with baking paper for 25-30 minutes golden brown.

Remove hip steak from the refrigerator for about 20 minutes before frying and pat dry. Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan at high heat. Fry the steak on each side for 2–3 minutes and allow to soak for 2–4 minutes in a small heat (medium: 54–57 °C core temperature). Let salt, pepper and wrapped in aluminium foil rest for 5 minutes.

Peel the onion and dice finely. For the pepper cream sauce, sauté the onion in the frying fat, stir in cream and mustard, season with dried herbs and plenty of coarsely ground pepper and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Place the meat with the side dish and add the sauce.

Clean mushrooms and slice them, peel onion and dice finely. Fry mushrooms and onion in frying fat for 4–5 minutes until they have paint, add cream and simmer for 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add parsley (chopped).

Peel the peppers and dice them, peel the onion and dice them finely. Sweat the peppers and onion in frying fat for 3-4 minutes, fry the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add pasted tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
For the herb butter, let the butter soften. Chop garlic finely and mix with a portion of the herbs (fine chopped) and a pinch of salt under the butter; until served, put it cold.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C above/underheat. Wash potatoes and quarter with peel. Mix the potatoes with half of the olive oil, salt and other herbs (best rosemary) and bake on a sheet with baking paper for 25-30 minutes golden brown.
Place the meat with the side dish and melt the herb butter in flakes on it.

Cut the onion into fine strips and fry for 3–4 minutes in the frying fat. Deglaze with vegetable broth, remove from the stove and stir in sour cream with mustard – do not cook anymore, otherwise the sour cream flakes out.
Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve, boil with the double amount of salt water and leave to boil for 12–15 minutes over a small heat.

Remove hip steak from the refrigerator about 20 minutes before frying and pat dry. Heat olive oil in a frying pan at high heat. Fry the steak on each side for 2–3 minutes and allow to soak for 2–4 minutes in a small heat (medium: 54–57 °C core temperature). Let salt, pepper and wrapped in aluminium foil rest for 5 minutes.
Gently chop garlic and stir with herbs (finely chopped) and a pinch of salt into the butter until served until cold.
Peel, dice sweet potatoes and cook softly in salt water for 12-15 minutes. Drain and stir with milk and butter into a smooth puree; season with salt.
For the herb butter, let the half of the butter soften. Chop garlic finely and stir with herbs (fine chopped) and a pinch of salt under the butter; until served, put it cold.
Peel, dice sweet potatoes and cook softly in salt water for 12-15 minutes. Drain and stir with milk and the remaining butter into a smooth puree; season with salt.
Heat Spätzle in boiling salt water for 1-2 minutes and drain.
Preheat the oven to 220 °C above/underheat. Spread French fries in one layer on a sheet with baking paper and bake for 15-20 minutes according to the package.
Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over it with vegetable broth (hot, filled with boiling water to about 1.5 times the couscous quantity), let it spring for 5 minutes and loosen up with a fork.

Put the couscous in a bowl, pour over with a portion of the vegetable broth (hot, filled with boiling water to about 1.5 times the couscous quantity), let it soak for 5 minutes and loosen up with a fork.

Cut the onion into fine strips and fry for 3–4 minutes in the frying fat. Deglaze with the remaining vegetable broth, remove from the stove and stir in sour cream with mustard – do not cook anymore, otherwise the sour cream flakes out.

Boil milk with water (together about four times the quantity of polenta) and a pinch of salt. Drain polenta under constant stirring and let it pour creamy at a small heat according to the package (Instant-Polenta about 5 minutes).
Cut half of the onion into fine strips and fry crispy with fried potatoes in a coated pan without additional fat for 6-8 minutes.

Peel the rest of the onion and dice finely. For the pepper cream sauce, sauté the onion glassy in the frying fat, stir in cream and mustard, season with dried herbs and plenty of coarsely ground pepper and simmer for 2-3 minutes.

Clean mushrooms and slice them, peel the rest of the onion and dice finely. Fry mushrooms and onion in frying fat for 4–5 minutes until they are in colour, pour on cream and simmer for 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add parsley (chopped).
Peel the rest of the onion and dice finely. Sweat the peppers and onion in frying fat for 3-4 minutes, roast the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add pasted tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cut onion into fine strips and fry crispy with fried potatoes in a coated pan without additional fat for 6-8 minutes.

Cut the rest of the onion into fine strips and fry in the frying fat for 3-4 minutes. Deglaze with vegetable broth, remove from the stove and stir in sour cream with mustard – do not cook any more, otherwise the sour cream flakes out.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C above/underheat. Wash the zucchini and cut into 2 cm pieces, core the peppers and cut into 2–3 cm pieces, peel the carrots and cut them into pins. Mix the vegetables with half of the olive oil and salt and roast on a sheet of baking paper for 20–25 minutes until they are soft and lightly browned.

Preheat the oven to 200 °C above/underheat. Wash the zucchini and cut into 2 cm pieces, core half of the peppers and cut into 2–3 cm pieces, peel carrots and cut into pins. Mix the vegetables with half of the olive oil and salt and roast on a sheet of baking paper for 20–25 minutes until soft and lightly browned.

Peel the rest of the peppers and dice them small, peel the onion and dice finely. Sweat the peppers and onion in frying fat for 3-4 minutes, fry the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add the pastry tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes.
Let potato dumplings draw in boiling salted water according to the package – do not boil bubbling, otherwise they disintegrate. Sprinkle with herbs (hacked) before serving.
Let potato dumplings draw in boiling salted water according to the package – do not boil bubbling, otherwise they disintegrate. Sprinkle with the other herbs (hacked) before serving.

Knead the beef with salt and pepper and form 8–10 small balls with wet hands. Heat the remaining olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the balls around 8–10 minutes until they are cooked, and remove them.
Knead the beef with salt and pepper and form 8–10 small balls with wet hands. Heat olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the balls around 8–10 minutes until they are cooked and remove.

Cut beef across the fiber into thin strips – so the legmeat remains tender in the short cooking season. Heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan at high heat. Sauté the meat in the meat in proportion for 3-4 minutes, salt, pepper, remove and keep warm.

Cut beef across the fiber into thin strips – so the legmeat remains tender in the short cooking season. Heat olive oil in a pan at high heat. Sauté the meat in it for 3-4 minutes, salt, pepper, remove and keep warm.

Cut pork fillet into 3 cm thick medallions, slightly press flat and season. Heat the remaining olive oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the medallions from each side for 3-4 minutes until they are tender pink inside (core temperature 63 °C), remove and leave to rest in aluminium foil.

Cut pork fillet into 3 cm thick medallions, press slightly flat and season. Heat olive oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the medallions from each side for 3-4 minutes until they are tender pink inside (core temperature 63 °C), take out and leave to rest in aluminium foil.
Tear the remaining olive oil in a frying pan at medium to high heat. Fry the schnitzel from each side for 2-3 minutes until it is cooked, remove it and keep warm.
Knock schnitzel thinly, salt it and pepper it. Heat olive oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the schnitzel from each side for 2-3 minutes until it is cooked, remove it and keep warm.

Cut chicken breast into mouth-appropriate pieces and season with salt and pepper. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the meat in it for 6-8 minutes all around golden brown until no pink core can be seen, and remove.

Roast sesame in a small pan without fat and put aside; cut spring onions into fine rings. Mix teriyaki sauce with soy sauce and sesame oil, put in the hot pan and let boil for 1 minute until the sauce shines.
Return the meat to the sauce, swirl briefly and serve with the side dish, sprinkle with roasted sesame and spring onions.
Chop garlic finely and sauté for 30 seconds in frying fat. Add honey, soy sauce and lemon juice and simmer in syrup for 1–2 minutes.
Return the meat to the sauce, swirl briefly and serve with the side dish.
Finely rub ginger and fry with red curry paste in frying fat for 1 minute. Pour in coconut milk, simmer for 3-4 minutes and season with lime juice.

Chop the garlic finely and dice the tomatoes. Sweat the garlic in the frying fat briefly, add the tomatoes and the tomato cubes and simmer for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add basil (topped).

Dice the zucchini and halve the cherry tomatoes. Fry the zucchini in frying fat for 3-4 minutes, cook the tomatoes for 1 minute. Remove the pan from the stove and stir in pesto – do not cook pesto anymore.
Peel the peppers and dice them, peel the onion and dice them finely. Heat the peppers and onion in frying fat for 4–5 minutes, stir in cream cheese with 2–3 tablespoons of water and heat them creamy.
Clean mushrooms and slice them. Fry mushrooms in frying fat for 4–5 minutes until they have paint, pour in cream and simmer for 2 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and add parsley (chopped).
Mix yoghurt with lemon juice, herbs (chopped) and garlic (fine grated) as well as salt and pepper. Add the sauce cold so that the yoghurt does not flocculate.
Put it all together and put the sauce over it.
Stir peanut with soy sauce, coconut milk and lime juice smoothly, put into the pan and heat creamy for 1-2 minutes in a small heat; if necessary dilute with some water.
Finely dice peppers and red onion and fry in frying fat for 3 minutes. Tomato paste for 1 minute, then add BBQ sauce and 2 tablespoons of water and let it boil.

Preheat the oven to 220 °C above/underheat. Wash potatoes and cut into narrow cracks with peel. Mix the cracks with olive oil, paprika powder and salt and bake crispy on a sheet with baking paper for 25-30 minutes; turn after half the time.

Preheat the oven to 220 °C above/underheat. Wash potatoes and cut into narrow cracks with peel. Mix the cracks with olive oil and salt and bake crispy on a sheet with baking paper for 25-30 minutes; turn after half the time.
Rinse quinoa hot in a sieve, boil with the double amount of salt water, simmer for 12–15 minutes and let it spout for 5 minutes.
Cook whole-grain noodles in plenty of salt water according to the package specification and drain them.

Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve, boil it with the double amount of salt water and leave it covered in a small heat for 12-15 minutes. Divide broccoli into small roes and place it on the rice for the last 5 minutes so that it cooks in the steam.

Pour the couscous with the 1.5 times the amount of boiling salt water, let it soak for 5 minutes and loosen it with a fork. Wash couscous and dice small, core peppers and dice small. Roast the vegetables in a coated pan for 3–4 minutes and lift them under the couscous.

Pour the couscous with the 1.5 times the amount of boiling salt water, let it soak for 5 minutes and loosen it with a fork. Wash half of the coucchini and dice it small, core the peppers and dice it small. Roast the vegetables in a coated pan for 3–4 minutes and lift them under the couscous.

Dice the remaining zucchini and halve the cherry tomatoes. Fry the zucchini in frying fat for 3-4 minutes, cook the tomatoes for 1 minute. Remove the pan from the stove and stir in pesto – do not cook pesto anymore.

Pour the couscous with the 1.5 times the amount of boiling salt water, let it soak for 5 minutes and loosen it with a fork. Wash and dice zucchini, core half the peppers and dice them small. Roast the vegetables in a coated pan for 3–4 minutes and lift them under the couscous.

Peel the rest of the peppers and dice them, peel the onion and dice them finely. Heat the peppers and onion in frying fat for 4–5 minutes, stir in cream cheese with 2–3 tablespoons of water and heat creamy.
Finely dice the rest of the peppers and red onion and fry for 3 minutes in the frying fat. Roast the tomato paste for 1 minute, then add BBQ sauce and 2 tbsp water and let it boil.

Cut turkey breast into mouth-appropriate pieces and season with salt and pepper. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the meat in it for 6-8 minutes all around golden brown until no pink core can be seen, and remove.
Knead the turkey with salt and pepper and form 8–10 small balls with wet hands. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan over medium heat. Fry the balls around 8–10 minutes until they are cooked, and remove them.
Peel, halve potatoes and cook softly in salt water for 18-20 minutes. Drain, evaporate briefly and swirl with parsley (fine chopped).

Dip salmon fillet dry and slightly salt. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium heat. Fry the salmon with the skin side down for 4 minutes, turn and cook for another 2-3 minutes until it is no longer glassy inside.
Mix yoghurt with herbs (best dill, finely chopped), lemon juice and mustard and season with salt and pepper.
Peel, halve potatoes and cook softly in salt water for 18-20 minutes. Drain, evaporate briefly and swirl with half of the parsley (fine chopped).
Chop the garlic finely and let it soak in the olive oil for 1 minute in a small heat without browning. Remove from the stove, stir in lemon juice and the remaining parsley (chopped) and salt.
Dice tomatoes and cut olives into rings. Simmer in a small pot of tomatoes and olives for 5 minutes, salt, pepper and add basil (truncated).
Place the fish with the side dish and add the sauce.

Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve, boil with the double amount of salt water and let it soak for 12-15 minutes over a small heat. Loose the finished rice with a portion of the lemon juice and some salt.
Mix yoghurt with herbs (best dill, finely chopped), the remaining lemon juice and mustard and season with salt and pepper.
Chop the garlic finely and let it soak in the olive oil for 1 minute in a small heat without browning. Remove from the stove, stir in the remaining lemon juice and parsley (chopped) and salt.
Rinse the basmati rice in a sieve, boil with the double amount of salt water and let it soak for 12-15 minutes over a small heat. Loose the finished rice with lemon juice and some salt.
Chop the garlic finely and let it soak in the olive oil for 1 minute in a small heat without browning. Remove from the stove, stir in lemon juice and parsley (chopped) and salt.

Boil bulgur with the double amount of salt water and let it pour for 10–12 minutes over a small heat. Wash and dice zucchini, core peppers and dice small. Roast the vegetables in a coated pan for 3–4 minutes and lift them under the bulgur.

Rinse quinoa hot in a sieve, boil with the double amount of salt water, simmer for 12–15 minutes and pour out for 5 minutes. Wash spinach (dry and express TK-spinach) and lift it under the hot quinoa until it collapses.
Dip cod juice dry and slightly salt. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium heat. Fry the fish from each side for 3-4 minutes and gently turn; it is even if it is easy to divide.
Dip the fillet dry and slightly salt. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium heat. Fry the fish from each side for 3-4 minutes and gently turn; it is even if it is easy to divide.
Dip largemouth fillet dry and slightly salt. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium heat. Fry the trout with the skin side down for 3 minutes, turn and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Rinse shrimp cold, dry and remove the intestine if necessary. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the shrimps in it for 2-3 minutes until they are all around pink.
Drain the tuna well and pick coarsely with a fork. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan and heat the tuna in it for only 1 minute – longer frying makes it dry.
Chop smoked salmon into broad strips – it is not heated. To serve, drizzle with rapeseed oil.

Drain tofu, squeeze between kitchen paper and cut into 2 cm cubes. Heat rapeseed oil in a pan at medium to high heat. Fry the tofu cubes in them for 8–10 minutes all around golden brown and crispy. Divide broccoli into small skirts and fry for the last 4 minutes.
Swallow everything in the sauce briefly and serve with the side dish.
